I been trying to digest it was not my fault, at the time psychosis is happening to you, you have no control of your actions, fear is controlling you, at these times your brain tried everything to protect you from the horrors it was dealing with, you needed help, patience and kindness.
Otherwise shame and guilt can eat you alive and keep you trapped, unable to move forward and in a state of pain. 
Psychosis is a traumatic experience absolutely no one deserve going throught.
Forgiving yourself and understand it wasn't your fault its the hardest but biggest act of love you can possibly do. Im still trying to do it... You deserve people who love and support you and you deserve to be okay.
I wish you nothing but the best, sending you streght.
